snapshot.termsSummary: Terms require visible linked attribution text “Flight data from Avinor” to point to https://www.avinor.no/ and appear close to the data; see termsURL. Contact Avinor before heavy server load. Only one OSL XML query was made.
snapshot.scopeNote: Upcoming scheduled passenger flights in one OSL snapshot only; not a recurring timetable, inventory, award-seat, bookability or actual-departure source. Revalidate or mark stale after validUntilUTC.
